timeline.text: A rich man said:
I inherited all of this, from my fathers and their fathers before them.
He was lying.
And the man standing in front of him knew it… because he was the one Allah had sent to give him all of this.
Three men were given everything they asked for.
Then the angel who brought it came back… to test them.
Long ago, among the Children of Israel, there were three men.
One was a leper.
People kept away from him.
One was bald. People turned away from him.
And one was blind.
Allah willed to test them. So He sent them an angel.
The first man was a leper, and people kept away from him.
One day, the angel came to him and asked him: "What would you love most?"
He said:
Good colour, good skin. People find me disgusting.
The angel wiped his hand over him…
And the disease was gone.
Good colour. Good skin. But this gift was the start of his test.
Then the angel asked: "And what kind of wealth would you love most?"
He said:
Camels.
So he was given a she-camel, heavy with young. And the angel said: "May Allah bless you in her."
Then the angel walked on… to the second man.
The second man was bald, and people turned away from him too.
The same angel came to him and asked: "What would you love most?"
He said:
Good hair. And for this to be taken away from me. People find me disgusting.
The angel wiped his hand over him… and his hair grew back.
Then the angel asked: "And what kind of wealth would you love most?"
He said:
Cows.
So he was given a pregnant cow. And the angel said: "May Allah bless you in her."
Then the angel walked on… to the third man.
The third man was blind.
The same angel came to him too, and asked: "What would you love most?"
He said:
That Allah gives me back my sight… so I can see people.
The angel wiped his hand over him…
And Allah gave him back his sight.
Then the angel asked: "And what kind of wealth would you love most?"
He said:
Sheep.
So he was given a sheep, ready to give birth.
The camel gave birth.
The cow gave birth.
The sheep gave birth.
And they kept on multiplying…
Until one man had a valley full of camels. One had a valley full of cows. And one had a valley full of sheep.
Three poor men… had become rich.
And then, the angel came back.
The man who had once been a leper now owned a whole valley of camels.
Then a poor traveller came to him, his skin diseased, looking just the way he used to look.
It was the angel.
He said: "I am a poor man.
Every means I had for my journey has been cut off.
Today I can only reach my destination with Allah's help, and then yours."
"I ask you, by the One who gave you good colour, good skin and all this wealth: give me one camel, so I can finish my journey."
The man said:
The demands on my wealth are many.
The angel said: "I think I know you.
Weren't you a leper whom people found disgusting?
Weren't you poor…
and then Allah gave you all of this?"
The man said:
I inherited all of this, from my fathers and their fathers before them.
The angel said: "If you are lying… may Allah return you to how you were."
Next, the angel came to the man who had once been bald, now the owner of a whole valley of cows.
He came in the form and look of a bald man… and asked him just as he had asked the first.
And the man gave the very same answer.
He said:
The demands on my wealth are many.
And when the angel reminded him who he used to be, he said:
I inherited all of this, from my fathers before me.
The angel said: "If you are lying… may Allah return you to how you were."
Two men had been tested. Now only one was left.
The man who had been blind.
Last, the angel came to the man who had once been blind, now the owner of a whole valley of sheep.
He came in the form of a blind man, and said: "I am a poor man, a traveller.
Every means I had for my journey has been cut off.
Today I can only reach my destination with Allah's help, and then yours."
"I ask you, by the One who gave you back your sight: give me one sheep, so I can finish my journey." Two men had already turned him away.
The man said:
I was blind… and Allah gave me back my sight. I was poor… and He made me rich.
So take whatever you want. By Allah, I will not hold back anything you take for Allah today.
The angel said: "Keep your wealth.
All three of you were only being tested."
"Allah is pleased with you… and He is angry with your two companions."
Three men were tested the same way.
Two of them gave the very same answer:
I inherited all of this, from my fathers and their fathers before them.
And one answered:
I was blind… and Allah gave me back my sight. I was poor… and He made me rich.
Two of them forgot where it came from.
One remembered.
The angel asked each of them: "What would you love most?"
What would you have asked for?
Tell us in the comments.
